additions.name: KAGOYA Japan Keihanna Lab Existing Operations

locator.precision: Google Maps named facility point for KAGOYA Japan Keihanna Lab, used as a labelled campus/property locator for the A/B facility. It does not establish a surveyed campus boundary, individual A/B building footprint, entrance, data hall or proposed future container facility.
locator.identity_review: Independent name-only Google Maps search selected KAGOYA Japan Keihanna Lab (Data Center). Its original response explicitly joins that exact name and selected-object coordinates; the root separately observed the official kagoya.jp/datacenter/ website and Seikadai 7-4-5 address in the rendered UI. The operator page names the same lab and groups A and B buildings in one facility; the dated October 13 release names its Kyoto lab and continuing DC-backed services. The current Kansai Research Institute Seika/Nishi-Kizu directory independently lists the same lab and links KAGOYA. Current primary pages inspected do not supply the street address: 7-4-5 is identified as the compiled-reference map address, not falsely attributed to the operator. Neither the Kyoto headquarters nor the different Kagoya Tatara/EdgeConneX campus in Kyotanabe is selected.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Google Maps provides no measured horizontal accuracy for the selected place. Source decimal places are retained without implying survey precision or a known offset to operational data halls.

status.summary: Operator article published September 24 explicitly says KAGOYA FLEX provides services from its own Keihanna Science City data center and links the current page naming Keihanna Lab. September 24 is the conservative publication-based observation. The captured version was modified October 9; the specific operating sentence revision date is unknown. No exact opening or achieved expansion event is inferred.

additions.distinctness_review: All 422 sites, 448 projects, 2,274 evidence rows and 231 original source records screened. Broad KAGOYA matches identify the separate Tatara/EdgeConneX campus in Kyotanabe. Nearest baseline marker is EdgeConneX Greater Osaka campus (Kagoya Tatara Campus, Kyotanabe), 7,483.4 metres away. No baseline geometry envelope contains this marker and no selected-source collision occurs.
additions.successor_review: A and B buildings are parts of the same operator-named Keihanna Lab facility. Future phase evidence at this lab must attach to this physical site if identity remains supported. The October collaboration envisages container facilities elsewhere; it does not create a current lab expansion or authorize merging those future sites. Kagoya Tatara/EdgeConneX in Kyotanabe is a separate campus.
